info.title: PrimeCare communication API implementation contract
info.description: Typed registered contracts and implemented transport behavior. This document is not proof of deployment, grants, business-tool connectivity or live acceptance. All examples are synthetic. Replace the invalid deployment host only after deployment verification.

servers.description: Deployment required; no live server is asserted.

deploymentHost.description: Exact independently verified API host. Do not enter provider credentials or secrets here.

get.summary: Upgrade the exact signed WebSocket request
get.description: Upgrade the exact signed WebSocket request. The relay rechecks canonical call, OTP identity, durable session claim and task authorization; no caller-selected actor or tenant is trusted. This registered route is not activated by documentation. Query strings and fragments are rejected. Provider identity is never accepted as native user authentication.

101.description: Switching Protocols. Original client WebSocket is returned; no HTTP response body. Subsequent relay frames are not described as ordinary REST responses.

post.summary: Persist, deduplicate or quarantine signed delivery observations before returning 204
post.description: Persist, deduplicate or quarantine signed delivery observations before returning 204. Delivery callbacks are not SMS read receipts. This registered route is not activated by documentation. Query strings and fragments are rejected. Provider identity is never accepted as native user authentication.

204.description: Callback durably accepted; no response body.

post.summary: Verify the exact signed Twilio form and persist the inbound SMS before returning empty TwiML
post.description: Verify the exact signed Twilio form and persist the inbound SMS before returning empty TwiML. Durable duplicates do not create a second AI turn. Control messages and unsupported media stay outside the AI queue. The provider signature does not authenticate a PrimeCare account; verified linking and current consent remain required for any reply. Registration does not mount or activate this route. This registered route is not activated by documentation. Query strings and fragments are rejected. Provider identity is never accepted as native user authentication.

200.description: Successful transport/service response; not evidence of a confirmed appointment.

nativeSession.description: Opaque current PrimeCare session token, not a JWT or Vapi management key. Voice APIs reject cookie-only access. Identity and tenant come from the server session.

twilioSignature.name: X-Twilio-Signature
twilioSignature.description: Twilio-generated signature verified with the server Auth Token and exact configured public URL. Never send the Auth Token in this header. WebSocket signatures use the configured WSS URL.

Error400.description: Malformed, invalid or oversized input. Body limits are host-configured; do not retry unchanged requests.

Error401.description: Missing, invalid or expired native session.

Error403.description: Signature, origin, permission, current identity or resource scope denied.

Error404.description: Unregistered route, wrong origin, or scoped resource unavailable.

Error405.description: Wrong HTTP method. Inspect Allow header.

Error409.description: Version, state or idempotency conflict. Do not retry mutations automatically.

Error413.description: Host request or media byte limit exceeded.

Error503.description: Dependency or validation failure. A mutation may already have committed; reconcile before retry.
